Web_Disclaimer: Unofficial tool. Game assets are the property of Kuro Games.
Web_NoticeOpenOriginal: Open link in a new window
Web_SiteAccountHint: A site account keeps your Convene records and account data in the cloud. It is unrelated to your game account. You can also import Convene records without signing in, but they are then stored only in this browser.
Web_SignInRequired: Sign in to keep your Convene records and account data in the cloud and see them on any device.
Web_ExportHint: Download all pull records and account data (JSON). No credentials are included.
Web_DeleteAccountConfirm: This deletes your site account and all Convene records and account data of the linked UIDs. This cannot be undone.
Web_BindUidHint: Paste the link from the in-game Convene history. The site uses it once to fetch your records, confirm the UID is yours and import them; the link itself is not stored.
Web_Verifying: Verifying and importing, this takes a few seconds…
Web_Transferred: This UID was bound to another site account and has been moved to yours.
Web_UnbindConfirm: All pull records and account data stored for UID {0} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Web_TransferNotice: UID {0} was bound by another site account holding its convene link on {1}; its data moved with it.
Web_LinkHowToHint: Open the convene history in game first, then run this command in Windows PowerShell; the link is copied to your clipboard.
Web_GameLoginHint: Your email and password are used only in your browser and sent directly to Kuro Games, never to this site. After signing in, the UIDs of this game account are linked to your site account and their level, exploration and vehicle data are synced.
Web_GlobalOnly: Account data is available for global servers only.
Web_RememberOauth: Remember authorization on this device for one-click refresh
Web_RememberOauthHint: The authorization is encrypted and stays in this browser; it can only read account data and is never uploaded.
Web_OauthExpired: Your game authorization has expired. Please sign in to the game account again.
Web_NoOauth: No authorization is saved on this device. Please sign in to the game account first.
Web_UidNotInAccount: UID {0} is not in this game account.
Web_CaptchaHint: Security verification required, complete it in the popup.
Web_NeedUidHint: Link a UID on the Account page with a Convene URL or your game account.
Web_NeedProfileHint: Sign in to the game account (global only) to sync home, exploration and motor data.
Web_PrivacyBody1: Stored by this site: your username and a password hash (never the password itself), the UIDs you link, Convene records fetched with your link or uploaded from your browser, and account data (level, exploration, vehicle and so on).
Web_PrivacyBody2: Not stored by this site: your game password, game credentials, Convene link or guide-site authorization. Game sign-in happens only in your browser; when syncing character data, the guide-site authorization only passes through this site’s server for relaying; Convene records imported without signing in stay in this browser only.
Web_PrivacyBody3: Only one essential session cookie is used; no analytics or ad scripts. You can export or delete all your data at any time.
Web_CopyFailed: Copy failed. Please select and copy it manually.
Web_UserNameHint: 3–32 characters: letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots. Used to sign in; it cannot be changed later.
Web_PasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse your game account password.
Web_RecoverHint: This site does not collect email addresses, so a forgotten password can only be reset with the recovery code you saved when signing up. A new recovery code is issued after the reset.
Web_RecoveryCodeHint: If you forget your password, this recovery code is the only way to reset it. It is shown only once, so copy it and keep it somewhere safe.
Web_PasswordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
Web_RegenerateRecoveryHint: The old recovery code stops working immediately.
Web_AddUidHint: Link with a Convene URL, or sign in to your game account (International) to link all of its UIDs.
Web_GameLinked: Linked {0} UID(s) and synced account data
Web_LocalGachaHint: Records imported without signing in are kept only in this browser and are lost if you clear its data. Sign in to upload them to the cloud.
Web_ImportLocalHint: No sign-in needed: paste the in-game Convene history link. Records are stored only in this browser.
Web_UploadNeedBind: Link UID {0} on the Account page first (Convene URL or game account), then upload.
Web_DeleteLocalConfirm: This removes the local Convene records of UID {0} from this browser. Cloud data is not affected.
Web_UploadRemoveLocal: Remove the local copy after uploading
Web_RolesNeedLogin: Sign in with "Link with game account" on the Account page (and remember the authorization) to sync character data.
Web_RolesSyncFailed: Account data was synced, but syncing character data failed. You can retry on the Characters page later.
Web_RolesRelayHint: Data comes from the official guide site, which does not allow other sites to call it directly, so this site’s server relays the requests. The guide authorization only passes through the server while syncing and is never stored or logged.
Web_TimelineHint: Scroll the wheel to move sideways
Web_DynamicBackgroundHint: Plays the game launcher background video and pauses while the page is hidden. Uses some extra bandwidth and performance.
Web_WelcomeTitle: Welcome to WwTool on the web
Web_WelcomeLead: The browser version of the Wuthering Waves toolbox, with the same look and features as the desktop app: Convene statistics, stamina and activity, Resonators, exploration, motorcycle and the event calendar. A few things to know first:
Web_WelcomeLocalText: Paste a Convene link on the statistics page to import and view your records. They are stored only in this browser.
Web_WelcomeCloudText: Create a site account (username and password, no email) and bind your UID to upload records to the cloud and view them on any device.
Web_WelcomeGameTitle: Game credentials stay in your browser
Web_WelcomeGameText: Sign in to your game account to sync stamina, exploration, Resonators and more. Your game password is used only in the browser and cleared right away; the refresh authorization is encrypted and kept on this device, never on the server.
Web_WelcomeUiTitle: The button at the bottom right
Web_WelcomeUiText: Each page's actions, such as fetching Convene records or refreshing data, live in the button at the bottom right. Rest the pointer on an empty area to fade the page and see the background.
